result.title: Catastrophic Overfitting is Weight Drift the Training Loss Cannot See
result.comment: 12 pages (including appendix), 7 figures, 6 tables. Code available at https://github.com/fzjcdt/co-weight-drift
result.summary: Fast adversarial training (FAT) makes robust training affordable by replacing the multi-step attack with a single-step one, but it suffers from catastrophic overfitting (CO): partway through training, robustness to multi-step attacks collapses to near zero while the single-step attack used for training keeps being repelled. We show that CO is a quiet escape of the weights. Across the event the network's clean behavior quietly improves, and moving from the weights just before CO to those just after it changes the training objective only marginally while destroying most of the robustness. The training objective is therefore nearly blind to the displacement it causes, so it exerts no force to undo it. The exponential moving average (EMA) of the weights, which FAT protocols already maintain, does not accumulate this drift and stays robust through the entire event. This observation suggests a nearly free fix: when validation robustness drops, reset the weights to their EMA. We build this guard on top of a coupling-based base method designed so that its average stays inside the robust region. The resulting training removes CO in every one of our runs and attains the strongest AutoAttack accuracy among fast methods on all three benchmark datasets, including a clear margin on CIFAR-100, where it also clears the multi-step reference at roughly half its cost. Code is available at https://github.com/fzjcdt/co-weight-drift.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究快速对抗训练中的灾难性过拟合（CO），指出其本质是训练损失几乎不可见的权重漂移，并提出在验证鲁棒性下降时把权重回滚到 EMA 的防护做法。
AI.relevance_reason: 内容是图像分类器的对抗鲁棒训练与优化动力学，不涉及视觉或多模态推理状态、证据使用或推理期决策，EMA 回滚也只是通用训练稳定性技巧，缺乏可供 LVR 核查的具体线索。
